subject: ozone example in plyr "divide and conquer".  Why set levels??

messages.author: e6aee7c34ba7001a
messages.subject: ozone example in plyr "divide and conquer".  Why set levels??
parts:
Why are levels set in the code on page 20? Is it correct to do so?
The month associated with the values changes!

> head(coefs_df)
lat long month value
1 -1.2 -101.3 Jan 251.3333
2 -11.2 -101.3 Jan 255.3333
3 -13.7 -101.3 Jan 256.6667
> levels(coefs_df$month) <- month.abbr
> head(coefs_df)
lat long month value
1 -1.2 -101.3 May 251.3333
2 -11.2 -101.3 May 255.3333
3 -13.7 -101.3 May 256.6667

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: ozone example in plyr "divide and conquer". Why set levels??
parts:
Hi Margaret,

Good catch - I think that must have been a left over from a previous
version of the code where I didn't set up the dimnames correctly.
You're correct that it should be removed.

Hadley
